question: Does Hugging Face Inference Endpoints (hourly dedicated GPU instances on AWS and GCP) need its own record? Its pricing page lists per-hour rows: aws nvidia-l4 x1 $0.8, aws nvidia-l40s x1 $1.8, aws nvidia-a100 x1 $2.5, gcp nvidia-l4 x1 $0.7, gcp nvidia-a100 x1 $3.6, gcp nvidia-h100 x1 $10; no RTX 4090, and the stored page states no billing granularity.
why: compute/hugging-face-inference covers per-token Inference Providers and lists no hourly card; the Endpoints rows at https://huggingface.co/docs/inference-endpoints/pricing (capture sha256:bd772ea3b98aaf6add3de9d93a58c6255e83a4d400e393a5626439abe1245c3c) belong to no record, and compute/huggingface-jobs holds the separate Jobs rate list.
